turns.user: why are the romanian deadlifts after the squats and not before
turns.reply:
It's all about managing fatigue and keeping you safe under the bar. 

Barbell Back Squats are your main compound lift today—they are a "Tier 1" lift that taxes your central nervous system, your core, and almost every muscle in your lower body. Because squats require a massive amount of stability and energy, we want you hitting them when you are completely fresh. 

If we did Romanian Deadlifts (RDLs) first, your lower back, hamstrings, and glutes would already be fatigued by the time you got under the squat bar. A tired lower back is the main thing that causes squat form to break down, which increases your risk of injury. By doing squats first, we make sure you have maximum strength and focus for the heaviest lift, and then we use the RDLs to specifically target and overload your hamstrings and glutes afterward. 

Does that make sense, Ashley?
